lines.en: I hover high so I can look down on things.

lines.zh: 开火要留出四发的距离。
lines.en: Firing needs room for four shots.
I travel a straight line, never around.
The hive is only a perch I borrow.
My shell is thinner than my kin's, but accurate.

lines.zh: 我在找没有遮挡的角度。
lines.en: I am looking for an angle without cover.
Hovering is the only proper way to shoot down.
Four in a row makes a proper formation.
The trees below block their sight, not mine.
I do not land; landing is losing.
The spores queue up inside my shell.
Right wind, right trajectory.
Do not follow too closely; I am about to fire.
Everything from up here belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我往下压了半格，找平射的角度
lines.en: I drop half a block to find a level shot.

lines.zh: 壳里的弹已经排到第三发
lines.en: The third round is already loaded in my shell.
I am waiting for a clear line of sight.
Four are loaded; I have not chosen a recipient.

lines.zh: 僭主不需要王座，只要高度。
lines.en: A usurper needs height, not a throne.

lines.zh: 壳里的孢子偶尔炸一颗。
lines.en: A spore pops inside my shell now and then.

lines.zh: 我数着目标露头的间隔。
lines.en: I count the gaps when targets show themselves.

lines.zh: 蜂巢的事，我听着，不听令。
lines.en: I hear the business of the hive; I do not obey.

lines.zh: 我的准头，是唯一的长处。
lines.en: Accuracy is my only virtue.
High up the wind is strong; I do not mind.
Mycelium on the left, explosive on the right.

lines.zh: 我一直在算你躲的角度。
lines.en: I keep calculating where you will dodge.
This body is lighter than it looks.

lines.zh: 被召唤的东西，也想当主人。
lines.en: Even summoned things dream of being master.
You look up, and I have a target.
You are dead center in my sight.
Do not blink; I am aiming at your eyes.

lines.zh: 你躲在树下，只挡了一半。
lines.en: Behind that tree you are only half covered.

lines.zh: 你的手一抖，准星就废了。
lines.en: Your hands shook; the sight is spoiled.

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，看谁先动。
lines.en: We watch each other; let us see who moves first.
Your outline is very clear; thank you.
That face is saved for my first shot.
You are standing well; do not change pose.

lines.zh: 看过我的人，都记得天空。
lines.en: Everyone who has seen me remembers the sky.
The shell is thin, but I fly high.
That knocked my trajectory half a block off.
Do not hit the shell; there is ammunition inside.

lines.zh: 六十点，够我换两次位置。
lines.en: Sixty points; enough for two relocations.

lines.zh: 你打中了我，也就这一次。
lines.en: You hit me; it will not happen twice.
Green blood on your hand will not wash off.
The hive never taught me to retreat.
It hurts, but my aim holds.
The crack is venting spores; convenient.
Hit me again and I rise another layer.
The hive feeds me ammunition, not meals.
Your food will not stop one shot.
Move it; it is blocking my firing line.

lines.zh: 我只对会炸的东西感兴趣。
lines.en: Only things that explode interest me.
Summoned things do not need to eat.
Holding that up covers your face nicely.

lines.zh: 这味道太软了，我不喜欢。
lines.en: That smell is too soft for me.
Food is for those down below.
Keep it; you will not live to finish.
I take ammunition, not bread.
Do not touch; four shots are inside this shell.
You knocked me off aim; now I recalibrate.
What you bumped into was a magazine.
Back off; do not touch me while I load.
That bump just marked your position for me.
I am poor at close quarters; get away.
You have spore dust on your shoulder.
Bumping me only makes me rise.
Six points of armor; do not try twice.
This close, four shots would be wasted.
A usurper stands beside no one.

lines.zh: 新的我，由蜂巢肿瘤照抄。
lines.en: New ones of me are copied by the hive tumor.

lines.zh: 我连蜂巢都不认，何况配偶。
lines.en: I do not even acknowledge the hive, let alone a mate.
Want offspring? Ask the ones who split.

lines.zh: 两个我，只会争同一个角度。
lines.en: Two of me would only fight for one angle.

lines.zh: 我的位置太高，没人配站。
lines.en: My perch is too high for anyone to share.
The shell rots; the position remains.
No courtship, only succession.

lines.zh: 别问，你在浪费我的视线。
lines.en: Do not ask; you are wasting my line of sight.
I would rather hover alone.
I pick things up to restock ammunition.
This hard thing will do as a projectile.
From the ground I pick only what can burst.
Leave it; that is my next shot.
One slot in my shell is empty; perfect.
The less I carry, the steadier I fly.
This gravel will scatter nicely.
Once I take it, I climb back up.
Not the light ones; they do not hurt.
What the hive owns, I take as I please.
The line of sight is clear, and so is your fate.
The hive has allotted you to me.
The moment you showed yourself was enough.
Four shots for one target is a luxury.
I do not chase; I wait for you to leave the tree.
The sky has seen your position.
The proto-hive mind nodded.
From here your armor seams are plain.
That last one was a ranging shot.
Leaving the woods does not make you safe.
The four will fall in a single line.
I am deciding whether you go left or right.

lines.zh: 第一发标定，后三发收人。
lines.en: The first ranges you; the last three collect.

lines.zh: 你背后的石头，挡不住爆炸。
lines.en: The stone behind you will not stop the blast.
Do not hide behind the shield; it goes first.

lines.zh: 这角度，正好封死你的路。
lines.en: This angle seals off your path nicely.
The wind drifts right; I correct left.
That whistle you hear is my sight aligning.
Count to four, and you should move.

lines.zh: 我瞄的是落脚点，不是你。
lines.en: I aim at where you will land, not at you.

lines.zh: 贴这么近，我零距离开火。
lines.en: This close, I fire at point-blank.

lines.zh: 四发全打进你胸口，浪费。
lines.en: All four into your chest; wasteful.
My shell can strike, too.

lines.zh: 近身不是我的活，但够用。
lines.en: Close work is not mine, but it will do.
You came in; do not blame me.
This one is explosive; step back.
The mycelium round opened on your face.
My aim only improves up close.
Do not grab my shell; it bursts.
That emptied the magazine.

lines.zh: 蜂巢肿瘤吐了口气，我成形。
lines.en: The hive tumor exhaled, and I took shape.

lines.zh: 雏型蜂巢思维要一个射手。
lines.en: The proto-hive mind needed a shooter.
First I claim the highest position.
Four rounds are already seated in my shell.

lines.zh: 这片天空往下，都听我的。
lines.en: From this sky downward, I give the orders.
Do not search upward; I am already there.

lines.zh: 召唤我的人，也别指望我听话。
lines.en: Whoever summoned me should not expect obedience.
The spores have lined up inside my shell.
I arrive, and sightlines stop being safe.

lines.zh: 六点护甲，够我开完四发。
lines.en: Six armor points; enough to fire all four.
The shell fears fire; the spores do not.
If I fall, the four shots scatter.
I cannot fire underwater.
Even my own ammunition bursts on me.
An arrow for an arrow; fair.
The light pulls me down out of the sky.
I live on summoning, not on meals.

lines.zh: 雷追着我，因为我站得高。
lines.en: Lightning follows me because I stand high.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有可俯视的东西。
lines.en: In the void there is nothing to look down on.
